name: Tempester 1.6.9.0 — every Tempester Voice version recognised
summary: Everything in 1.6.8.0; the Release lift to 127 and the repeated full backup now recognise every Tempester Voice version, Tempester Voice 1.5.1.2 included. Install it before Tempester Voice 1.5.1.2.

changes: Every Tempester Voice version counts as Tempester Voice: Voice 1.5.1.0 and 1.5.1.1 as before, and Voice 1.5.1.2, which reports a version of its own, keeps the Release knobs up to 127 and its place in a second full backup.
Install this Main OS before Tempester Voice 1.5.1.2: on Main 1.6.8.0 or older a 1.5.1.2 chip is taken for an unknown Voice OS (Release back to 123, read once per power-on).

description: 1.6.8.0 with n°63 and n°62 in their 1.6.9.0 forms (n°65: patch/release_cap_1690.json in place of patch/release_cap_1670.json, patch/full_backup_1690.json in place of patch/full_backup_1680.json): the start-up Release lift and the full-backup re-alignment take a chip as Tempester Voice when its 0xFE00 word is 0x16-0x79, where 1.6.7.0 / 1.6.8.0 took exactly 0x16. The range: DSI 1.5 answers 0x15 and a silent chip 0x0000 / 0xFFFF (refused); main's start-up loop accepts 1-0x79 (upper bound). Every Tempester Voice from 1.5.1.0 on has what both gates rely on (finite Release 101-127, 0xF5nn dump pointer clear). Everything else is 1.6.8.0's: the image of this manifest with the 1680 / 1670 forms and 1.6.8.0's digits is 1.6.8.0 byte for byte (verify.sh step 2), and only VOICE_CHECK, ALIGN and the version digits differ. Proved in simulation (verify.sh --long step 17). Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged (Tempester Voice 1.5.1.2, versions/voice/1.5.1.2.json, goes on after this Main). Installed on 15/11/2026, then Tempester Voice 1.5.1.2: request 43 answers 1.6.9.0, message 45 reports six 0x17, two full backups in a row identical after each step.
